stem_en: A trust and company services provider that offers a variety of services to businesses is approached by a client interested in establishing a new company. The client requests assistance with the incorporation process, a local business address, annual maintenance services, and the designation of individuals to serve in official capacities for the new company. Which of the following services involves a higher money laundering risk?

options_en.A: Appointing individuals to serve in official capacities of the company
options_en.C: Provision of a local business address
